title: [DOC2-21] Five profiles use BCP 14 key words and carry no non-normative banner
description: Review finding DOC2-21: Five profiles use BCP 14 key words and carry no non-normative banner (lens DOC2). Location: profiles/o365-employer-did.md:1, gsuite-employer-did.md:1, universal-idp-did.md:1, discord-onboarding.md:1, purview-bridge.md:1; README.md:22 marks profiles/ non-normative. Fix: The headers read "# Specification:" or "Implementation Specification v0.1" and carry no banner. The other four profiles open with "> Non-normative." Under the reviewer's option (a), the o365:190 tightening (MUST where spec §2.5.2 :291 says SHOULD) is legitimate, because it binds only conformance to the profile. Full text: notes/review2/DOC2-verified.md and notes/review2/DOC2.md.
